name: Mamlambo
description: A river goddess and serpent water spirit of South African (especially Zulu and Xhosa) tradition, said to grant wealth to those who keep her — and to take a heavy toll from those who do.

aliases.name: Brain Sucker
aliases.meaning: Local nickname coined during the 1997 Mzintlava River reports

origin: Eastern and southern South Africa, particularly within Zulu and Xhosa cultural areas; the most widely reported modern episode centred on the Mzintlava River near Mount Ayliff in the Eastern Cape (1997).
